visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a steaming black ceramic pot filled with golden-yellow seafood porridge. A metal ladle scoops up white rice, pink shrimp, purple squid rings, and dark black squid ink balls. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the moist texture of the food. (2) A waiter wearing a dark red uniform and purple nitrile gloves is seen from the chest down, placing a large black pot onto a white table already filled with multiple plates of food. The setting is a clean, well-lit indoor restaurant. (3) The waiter's hands lift the ceramic lid from the pot, releasing a thick cloud of white steam that momentarily obscures the frame. In the background, other patrons sit at a distant wooden table. (4) A rapid sequence of extreme close-ups showcases various dishes: stir-fried green scallions with glossy brown meat slices, golden-brown cubes of fried radish cake seasoned with red chili flakes and green herbs, and soft tofu topped with bonito flakes. (5) Detailed close-up of a large cooked red crab, cut in half to display a generous amount of bright orange roe. It is garnished with chopped green onions and served on fresh green lettuce leaves. (6) A wide shot pans across the restaurant interior, showing a large round dining table with a lazy Susan, surrounded by light-colored wooden chairs. The decor features red walls, traditional Chinese wooden screens, and modern spherical lanterns. (7) The final shot shows the exterior of the restaurant at night; a large red sign with the gold characters '麟粥宮' is illuminated above the entrance.
